senses.sense_definition: Of plants or trees, keeping foliage throughout the year rather than shedding leaves seasonally.

examples.text: Pine and spruce are typical <w>evergreen</w> trees that stay green through the cold winter months.
Many gardeners plant <w>evergreen</w> shrubs along the fence to ensure privacy all year long.

senses.sense_definition: Continually fresh, enduring, or automatically renewing, retaining interest or legal effect over time.

examples.text: This classic love song remains an <w>evergreen</w> hit that every generation loves to sing.
The contract includes an <w>evergreen</w> clause that renews the service agreement automatically each year.

senses.sense_definition: Of digital content, software, or documentation: maintained continuously up to date rather than updated in periodic discrete versions.

examples.text: Modern browsers operate on an <w>evergreen</w> model by automatically downloading updates in the background.
We maintain an <w>evergreen</w> documentation site to reflect changes as soon as they are deployed.

senses.sense_definition: Of media or news stories, suitable for broadcast or publication at any time because the content is not time-sensitive.

examples.text: The magazine editor keeps several <w>evergreen</w> articles on hand to fill unexpected gaps in the schedule.
Interviews with local craftspeople make great <w>evergreen</w> features during slow news weeks.

senses.sense_definition: A plant, shrub, or tree that retains green leaves or needles throughout the year.

examples.text: A row of tall <w>evergreens</w> sheltered the country house from harsh northern winds.

senses.sense_definition: A conifer tree, such as a pine, spruce, or fir.

examples.text: Dense stands of native <w>evergreens</w> covered the mountainsides as far as the eye could see.

senses.sense_definition: A piece of journalism or news story that retains its relevance and can be published at any time.

examples.text: The newsroom held the feature as an <w>evergreen</w> until space opened up in the Sunday edition.
Reporters are encouraged to write an occasional <w>evergreen</w> for the holiday season.

senses.sense_definition: To prolong patent protections beyond the regular statutory limit, typically through slight variations of the existing product.

senses.sense_definition: To maintain or adjust repayment terms on a loan so low that the principal balance is never reduced.

examples.text: The bank chose to <w>evergreen</w> the troubled commercial loans instead of writing them off.
Critics warned that lenders who continuously <w>evergreen</w> bad debt conceal systemic insolvency.
